title: finding(types): objectui#9648 made its own neighbouring docblock false - "the ONE named refusal that reaches into it" is contradicted 31 lines below by text the same PR added, plus two more stale prose clauses in the same block
body:
Dedup keywords: `objectql.zod.ts:1312` · `THE LEGACY BAG` · `ONE named refusal` · `SECOND key family` · `merges before it reads anything` · stale docblock · objectui#9648 · objectui#8735

Surfaced by the at-tier contract review of objectui#9648 (record `5708455556`, VERDICT **PASS**, which classed these **non-blocking and unpublished**); filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat so that 「non-blocking」 does not become 「forgotten」. ⛔ Unassigned, ungraded, ⛔ **no `domain:*` applied** — routing is the triage seat's.

## (1) A lead sentence this PR falsified itself — re-derived by this seat

`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:1312`, unchanged by objectui#9648:

```
// THE LEGACY BAG, and the ONE named refusal that reaches into it
// (objectui#8365). Everything in here is `z.any()` and stays that way: …
```

`:1343`, **added by objectui#9648** — confirmed present in `git diff 0b7be13ad..77fbabc6e` as a `+` line:

```
// ⭐ objectui#8355 — the SECOND key family that reaches into this bag,
```

⇒ ⛔ **「the ONE named refusal」 is false, and the sentence that falsifies it is 31 lines below, inside the same check, added by the same PR.** A reader who stops at the lead sentence learns the wrong thing; a reader who goes on meets the correction with no signal that the first was superseded.

## (2) A sequence claim in the newly added text — also re-derived here

`:1344-1345`, added by the same PR:

> `ListView` merges `{ ...options.calendar, ...calendar }` **before it reads anything**

⛔ Not for the calendar branch. `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2756-2762` reads the three canonical keys through `||`, ahead of any merge:

```
const startDateField =
  schema.calendar?.startDateField || schema.options?.calendar?.startDateField;
const endDateField =
  schema.calendar?.endDateField || schema.options?.calendar?.endDateField;
const titleField =
  schema.calendar?.titleField || schema.options?.calendar?.titleField;
```

⚠️ The claim is **precedence-true** — the declared block does win — and **sequence-false**. ⭐ That distinction is not pedantry here: the sentence is load-bearing for *why* the refusal has to cover the legacy nesting, and the kanban branch one case over really does merge first, so a reader generalising from this comment to that one is right by accident and wrong by reasoning.

## (3) A PR-body clause, the review's reading, ⛔ not re-derived by this seat

The body still says 「two codes, one message per spelling」. The round-3 container split gave `dateField` **two** tails. ⚠️ This is the at-tier reviewer's measurement; ⛔ this seat has not re-run it. ⛔ And the PR body is not published to authors — it is recorded for whoever repairs (1) and (2), not as a defect of equal weight.

## ⭐ Why this is a card and not a nit

objectui#8735 — **closed/completed** — was 「four `zod/objectql.zod.ts` docblocks now state the opposite of what the code does」, the identical class in the identical file. ⇒ this is a **recurrence** of something this module has already been cleaned of once.

⚠️ And the shape is this shift's dominant failure mode: **a claim about the system carried in prose that nothing re-derives.** The same PR's review chain caught two of these in *published* strings across two rounds (a false 「never came through the validated path」, and a consequence clause false on one of its installed surfaces). ⇒ ⛔ the question worth asking here is not 「fix three comments」 but 「why does this module keep accruing counted claims (`ONE`, `four`, `two codes`) that no instrument counts」.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT claim

⛔ objectui#9648 is sound: PASS at tier on `77fbabc6e` with a 142/142 stamp control, after two earned FAILs. ⛔ Nothing here reopens it, and ⛔ nothing here is published to an author — all three live in tree prose or a PR body. ⛔ It also does not ask for a counting gate; whether one is worth building is the triage seat's call, and ⭐ a gate that counted these would itself be a claim needing an instrument.

## Provenance

At-tier record objectui#9648 comment `5708455556`; the landing provenance is comment `5708468550`. Items (1) and (2) re-derived at the branch head by this seat, printed above. Item (3) is the reviewer's.

⛔ This seat ran a dedup query over open **and** closed cards and found objectui#8735 (the closed precedent, cited above) and objectui#9653 (a different file and a published string). Dedup words are at the top.
